Dictionary mapping rail name to target rails where there needs to be a mapping. The target rail should correspond to a single non-binned row in the Binning sheet.
For example, ["VDD_SRAM_GPU"] = "VDD_SRAM_SOC" indicates that if VDD_SRAM_GPU is not in the current channel map, then VDD_SRAM_SOC is used as the voltage, where SRAM_SOC is a non-binned row of the Binning sheet.
